coverage.limitation: Creation draft, flat preset selection and rules/data-pack navigation do not prove every generator or rule combination.
Conversion and recovery are destructive flows and need dedicated disposable fixtures.
Saved-list management uses disposable loopback entries; server join, authentication and third-party services are not validated.
Horse chest layouts are separate actual fixtures. Crafter does not exist on 1.20.1; other containers do not inherit its toggle semantics.
BookSignScreen is separate only on newer Targets; the older editor signs in place. Front-side sign editing does not prove every side, waxed state or material.
External URL opening is not tested; native confirmation is preserved.
Account/service flows need actual authorization; server-authored dialogs remain pending local UI fixtures, not external-service PASS.

presentation.hudOcclusionPolicy: USER HUD text only with no Screen/Overlay; Toast text only fully shown
limitations: Late GUI text is observed after unchanged native draw submissions with actual pose, opacity and scissor. Partially clipped text exposes only bounds/phase. The independent 128-node frame binds world/camera/Screen/Overlay/GUI size for 250 ms and resets before each complete native GUI extraction; no hidden chat/effect cache or F3 server-chunk request is read. The ordinary HUD frame remains bounded to 32 nodes, separately from the native 80-row/64-part player-list frame
Typed Vanilla HUD: title/subtitle/actionbar, item hotbar, boss bars, sidebar, effect icons and player-list text; other HUD and third-party render overrides remain unsupported

Player list USER rows come from completed native name/header/footer, ping and formatted-score/heart draws; no profile identity, exact latency, raw scores or skins. An independent 80-row frame permits up to 64 submitted parts per row without enlarging the HUD budget. Context, native visibility and 250 ms age are checked on read; hidden native rows remain DEBUG-only
Effect icon opacity comes from the last completed native draw at the same player/Screen/GUI size, no older than 250 ms; no amplifier/duration or third-party draw guarantee

Toast text: System/Tutorial/Advancement/Recipe from native render callbacks; NowPlaying from text actually submitted within its resident native draw; no queued text or music-service internal state in USER

USER Toast nodes use completed native draw geometry bound to toast/world/camera/Screen/Overlay/GUI size for 250 ms; partial entry/exit exposes clipped bounds and phase without text, while fully shown text retains its native phase. This is not framebuffer or third-party occlusion proof

NowPlaying requires a completed resident draw within 250 ms at the same Toast/world/camera/Screen/GUI size; entering/exiting report the native phase and viewport-clipped background bounds without partial text. Full labels require a fully shown, wholly viewport-contained draw; static settings previews are not resident Toast samples
Item name, durability/cooldown and contextual bars use bounded completed native HUD draws; no raw item, XP, jump or waypoint state.

Vital icons are the ordered native glyph composition, including container/blinking/foreground layers; no raw health, food, air, saturation or mount statistics. The completed sample is world/camera/Screen/size bound, expires after 250 ms and fails closed beyond 256 glyphs; third-party draw replacement and final pixel occlusion are not guaranteed.
